Ticket:
Questions regarding pharmacy substitution messaging for out-of-stock meds

Hello support, I am dealing with an out-of-stock medication alert for a patient and need to switch them to an alternative therapeutic agent. I navigated to the prescription module and looked at the pharmacy notes section, but I want to make sure I am using the proper substitution messaging workflow so the local pharmacy gets the right switch request. Could you confirm the exact steps or documentation for handling this cleanly in the system?
